question: To whom is homage directed through these honorific epithets?
premises: The recipient is called best among the renowned
His feet are worshipped by those who have laid down the staff
The verse offers salutation to him
inference: Homage is directed to the supreme renowned one whose feet are worshipped by renunciants
uncertainties: nyasta+daṇḍa may refer to renunciants or those who have set aside punishment
plain_english: To the best of the renowned, whose feet are worshipped by those who have laid down the staff.
